That's exactly it. I pasted the address I'd already saved, and instead of a fourth card appearing, the count stayed at three and it jumped me right to the one I already had — gave it a little highlight, popped open its editor, and told me it was already saved. Nothing piled up.

That's the behavior I was hoping for when I said I don't want the same thing saved twice. It's unmistakable, and the fact that it drops me straight into editing the existing one means if I *was* trying to update something, I'm already right where I need to be. This part's a solid yes for me.
